# Cardinal

> Cardinal finds what drives Prometheus series and Loki log streams, and turns it into rules that cut them.

- Metrics: active series by job, metric and label; churn; histogram bucket analysis; usage in alerts and dashboards.
- Logs: streams, labels, ingest volume and repeated line patterns from Loki.
- Rules: exports Prometheus relabel configs, Grafana Alloy, Promtail and Loki limits, and applies Grafana Cloud Adaptive Metrics and Adaptive Logs.
- Agents: an MCP endpoint lets an AI agent analyse the connected data and propose rules for review.
- Everything runs in the browser; queries go straight to your backend or through a stateless proxy.

Source: https://github.com/TA3/cardinal
